question_answered: What is the accepted nuclear ancestry scaffold for Japan38?
decision_rationale: Required to place phenotype on evolutionary history; 236 QC loci/176 rootable loci/1000 UFBoot; branch lengths substitutions/site

question_answered: How many broad colonization histories produced the Japanese flora?
decision_rationale: Defines one dominant radiation plus rare exceptions and supplies historical context without replacing the focal tree

question_answered: Is phenotype disparity already large within the dominant radiation?
decision_rationale: Motivates how large disparity arose within a shallow radiation; not itself a rate estimate

question_answered: How many minimum orientation changes are required?
decision_rationale: 20 resolved; ML6; UFBoot4-6; strong recurrence lower bound

question_answered: How many phyllary-posture changes are required?
decision_rationale: 10 resolved; exactly3 on all 1000 UFBoot trees

question_answered: How many stickiness changes are required?
decision_rationale: 13 resolved; ML5; all 1000 UFBoot trees exactly5

question_answered: Do resolved discrete traits share one transition history?
decision_rationale: Existing result weakens one shared whole-capitulum lability, but predates final JPN34/JPN24 coverage

question_answered: Can continuous phenotype be analysed historically without categories?
decision_rationale: Shows trait-specific phylogenetic structure across lightness/chroma/hue and demonstrates continuous-history method

question_answered: Does the global/high-depth lightness history replicate in a balanced Japanese panel?
decision_rationale: Prevents universal convergence story and demonstrates evidence-scale dependence

question_answered: How do all Azami continuous endpoints map onto Japan38 ancestry?
decision_rationale: This is the largest missing symmetry with Chapter1 and should become the central new analysis

question_answered: Can Japan38 support absolute Ma transition timing?
decision_rationale: Current focal tree is substitutions/site and accepted absolute-time calibration is insufficient; useful as fail-closed calibration audit

question_answered: Do similar ecological shifts accompany repeated reproductive-trait evolution across plants?
decision_rationale: Useful external benchmark but not needed to establish Cirsium phenotype history

question_answered: What functions and fitness stages are altered by reproductive traits?
decision_rationale: Answers phenotype × function rather than phenotype × time; strong material should not be buried in Chapter2 supplement

question_answered: Do reproductive antagonists impose a fitness cost?
decision_rationale: Strong causal-channel result but does not establish trait history

question_answered: Is pollinator or antagonist dominance universal?
decision_rationale: Explains why functional effects may vary locally; belongs to why/function chapter

question_answered: Do broad functional classes predict selection strength?
decision_rationale: Useful negative result for function chapter; no phylogenetic-history estimand

question_answered: When do seed-level costs transmit to recruitment/demography?
decision_rationale: Downstream fitness interpretation; not needed for phenotype history

question_answered: Can display increase both mutualist and antagonist exposure?
decision_rationale: Direct functional ecology rather than history

question_answered: Can simple present-state biological driver generators reproduce Azami covariance targets?
decision_rationale: Uses present within/among phenotype targets and no phylogenetic transition history; belongs with Chapter1 structural robustness

question_answered: Can a null-like covariance generator reproduce the 62 scalar present-state targets?
decision_rationale: Important non-identifiability result for present-state compression but not Chapter2 time history

question_answered: Does the scalar winner reproduce held-out within/among support geometry?
decision_rationale: Strengthens Chapter1 scale-structure result; no phylogenetic axis

question_answered: What scale-specific process structure improves present-state fit?
decision_rationale: Diagnostic of among-vs-within covariance architecture rather than historical transitions

question_answered: Which covariance architecture first passes the seven-target adequacy screen?
decision_rationale: Potentially useful structural result but currently draft/provisional and should not enter Chapter2

question_answered: Where are functional benefits/costs strongest?
decision_rationale: Links environment to function rather than establishing history

question_answered: Are trait transitions coupled to niche shifts?
decision_rationale: Requires reliable trait histories first; can explain why histories occurred but should not block core Chapter2

question_answered: When did functional space expand or reoccupy?
decision_rationale: Depends literature-derived functional loadings; Chapter2 should first estimate phenotype disparity through time without function assumptions

question_answered: Do transitions cluster around ecological opportunity events?
decision_rationale: Needs dated transition history; currently calibration blocked

question_answered: Which evolutionary histories reproduce observed trait/niche patterns?
decision_rationale: Unlike current covariance simulations this could become true history-model discrimination, but only after empirical histories are frozen

question_answered: Which focal systems maximally discriminate mechanisms?
decision_rationale: Uses Chapter2 history to choose causal experiments

question_answered: Are repeated states retained, independently arisen, sorted or introgressed?
decision_rationale: Important for origin but not required for bounded phenotype-history paper
